prose: Salvatore Sanfilippo (antirez) explores alternatives to the EDIT tool that LLM coding agents use to modify files - the search-and-replace patching interface whose failures (stale context strings, partial matches, rewrites) are a daily friction of agentic coding. The captured page is thin - essentially the title - so the specific alternatives he evaluates cannot be detailed here; the topic itself is the signal: the EDIT primitive, not the model, is becoming the bottleneck worth redesigning.
